arXiv:2609.05327v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 9 月 4 日arXiv:2609.05327v1 [cs.AI] 04 Sep 2026

基于二元决策图的法学硕士驱动的量子电路综合算法设计LLM-Driven Algorithm Design for Quantum Circuit Synthesis based on Binary Decision Diagrams

Yoonju Sim syj5268@kaist.ac.krFederico Berto berto.federico2@gmail.comChuanbo Hua cbhua@kaist.ac.krJinkyoo Park jinkyoo.park@kaist.ac.krChanghyun Kwon chkwon@kaist.ac.kr Department of Industrial    Systems Engineering    KAIST    Daejeon    34141    Republic of Korea Radical Numerics    California    USA Omelet    Inc    Daejeon    34051    Republic of Korea†{\dagger} Corresponding author
摘要Abstract

量子电路是在量子设备上实现量子算法的核心，其中量子门必须是可逆的。许多量子算法依赖于布尔函数，因此必须在量子电路中可逆地实现。可逆电路综合提供了一种将此类布尔函数转换为可逆电路的方法。二元决策图 (BDD) 提供了一种可扩展的方法来完成此任务，但生成的 BDD 和电路在很大程度上取决于变量排序。现有的排序启发法通常会最小化 BDD 大小，因为它与电路大小密切相关。然而，BDD 大小并不能完美地代表合成电路 (QCC) 的量子成本。我们建议Quantum circuits are central to implementing quantum algorithms on quantum devices, where quantum gates must be reversible. Many quantum algorithms rely on Boolean functions, which must therefore be implemented reversibly within quantum circuits. Reversible circuit synthesis provides a way to translate such Boolean functions into reversible circuits. Binary decision diagrams (BDDs) offer a scalable approach to this task, but the resulting BDDs and circuits depend heavily on variable ordering. Existing ordering heuristics commonly minimize BDD size because it is closely tied to the circuit size. However, BDD size is an imperfect proxy for the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit (QCC). We propose量子演化QuantumEvo，一个进化框架，使用 LLM 作为 QCC 感知 BDD 变量排序的启发式生成器。不是直接预测订单，, an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator for QCC-aware BDD variable ordering. Instead of predicting orderings directly,量子演化QuantumEvo对从多个启发式家族初始化的排序启发式进行搜索。候选启发式使用标准 BDD 操作直接操纵变量排序，并由下游 QCC 选择。所发现的启发式 HGA-QE 修改了遗传算法内的筛选步骤，以便该过程更好地与 QCC 保持一致。在整个基准集上，HGA-QE 相对于每个功能的最佳基准实现了 70.9% 的平局或获胜率，并且在 13.5% 的功能上绝对是最佳的。结果表明，QCC 性能具有广泛的竞争性，HGA-QE 在严格获胜的两个基准套件中显示出更明显的相对优势，这两个基准套件的来源不同于启发式发现所用的数据。searches over ordering heuristics initialized from multiple heuristic families. Candidate heuristics directly manipulate variable orderings using standard BDD operations and are selected by downstream QCC. The discovered heuristic, HGA-QE, modifies the sifting step inside a genetic algorithm so that the procedure is better aligned with QCC. Across the benchmark set, HGA-QE achieves a 70.9% tie-or-win rate against the per-function best baseline and is strictly best on 13.5% of the functions. The results demonstrate broadly competitive QCC performance, with HGA-QE showing a clearer relative advantage in strict wins on the two benchmark suites drawn from sources different from the data used for heuristic discovery.

1 简介Introduction

随着量子算法和量子硬件的进步，量子计算越来越受到关注Quantum computing has attracted increasing attention with advances in both quantum algorithms and quantum hardware(Fedorov et al., 2022; Blekos et al., 2024; Bluvstein et al., 2024)。 要在量子设备上运行量子算法，其操作必须表示为量子电路，即量子门级联。 由于量子运算是酉的，因此量子电路是. To run a quantum algorithm on a quantum device, its operations must be expressed as a quantum circuit, i.e., a cascade of quantum gates. Since quantum operations are unitary, quantum circuits are可逆的reversible在大自然中。 许多量子算法包含布尔成分，例如预言函数in nature. Many quantum algorithms contain Boolean components, such as oracle functions(Grover, 1996; Simon, 1997)和算术子程序and arithmetic subroutines(Vedral et al., 1996)。 为了在量子电路中实现此类组件，必须将布尔函数嵌入到可逆变换中。 可逆电路综合通过将布尔函数转换为可映射到目标门库的可逆电路来解决此任务. To implement such components in a quantum circuit, a Boolean function must be embedded into a reversible transformation. Reversible circuit synthesis addresses this task by translating Boolean functions into reversible circuits that can be mapped to a target gate library(Shende et al., 2003; Wille et al., 2016)。 合成电路的质量通常通过其量子成本来评估，这反映了在量子门库下实现电路的成本。 我们将该指标称为合成电路的量子成本 (QCC)。. The quality of a synthesized circuit is often evaluated by its quantum cost, which reflects the cost of implementing the circuit under a quantum gate library. We refer to this metric as the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit (QCC).

已经开发了几种用于可逆电路合成的方法，包括基于变换的Several approaches have been developed for reversible circuit synthesis, including transformation-based(Miller et al., 2003)和基于周期的and cycle-based(Saeedi et al., 2010)。 此类方法可以为小型功能生成高质量电路，但随着输入数量的增加，它们的可扩展性受到限制。 基于 BDD 的综合旨在通过将布尔函数表示为二元决策图 (BDD) 并将生成的 BDD 结构转换为可逆电路来提高可扩展性. Such methods can produce high-quality circuits for small functions, but their scalability is limited as the number of inputs grows. A BDD-based synthesis aims to improve scalability by representing a Boolean function as a binary decision diagram (BDD) and translating the resulting BDD structure into a reversible circuit(Wille et al., 2009)。 由于变量排序强烈影响生成的 BDD，并且 BDD 大小提供了电路大小的上限，因此最小化 BDD 大小是排序方法的共同目标。 先前对变量排序方法（包括元启发法）的研究. Since variable ordering strongly affects the resulting BDD, and the BDD size provides an upper bound on the circuit size, minimizing the BDD size is a common objective for ordering methods. Previous studies on variable ordering methods, including metaheuristics(Bollig et al., 1995; Awad et al., 2022)和基于学习的方法and learning-based methods(Miao et al., 2026)，使用 BDD 大小作为目标。 然而，BDD 大小并不能完美地代表 QCC。 较小的 BDD 并不一定意味着较低的 QCC。 这激发了对直接减少下游 QCC 的 BDD 变量排序启发式的搜索。, have used the BDD size as an objective. However, BDD size is an imperfect proxy for QCC. A smaller BDD does not necessarily imply a lower QCC. This motivates the search for BDD variable ordering heuristics that directly reduce downstream QCC.

我们将其表述为启发式设计问题。 目标是发现一种可重用的 BDD 变量排序启发式算法，将每个布尔函数映射到具有低 QCC 的变量排序。 最近的法学硕士驱动的算法设计方法使用法学硕士来探索超出预定义集的更广泛的启发式程序空间We formulate this as a heuristic design problem. The goal is to discover a reusable BDD variable ordering heuristic that maps each Boolean function to a variable ordering with low QCC. Recent LLM-driven algorithm design methods use LLMs to explore a broader space of heuristic programs beyond a predefined set(Novikov et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2026; Huang et al., 2026)。 基于这个想法，我们建议. Building on this idea, we propose量子演化QuantumEvo11 1 源代码：Source code:https://github.com/syj5268/Quantumevo，一个使用 LLM 作为启发式生成器的进化框架。 它从多个启发式族中初始化搜索，并评估使用标准 BDD 操作操纵变量排序的可执行启发式。, an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator. It initializes the search from multiple heuristic families and evaluates executable heuristics that manipulate variable ordering using standard BDD operations.

我们的主要贡献如下： (1) 我们将 QCC 感知的 BDD 变量排序制定为启发式设计问题，并引入Our main contributions are as follows: (1) We formulate QCC-aware BDD variable ordering as a heuristic design problem and introduce量子演化QuantumEvo，一个 LLM 驱动的启发式搜索框架，使用下游 QCC 而不是 BDD 大小来评估可执行的排序启发式； (2), an LLM-driven heuristic search framework that evaluates executable ordering heuristics using downstream QCC rather than BDD size; (2)量子演化QuantumEvo发现 HGA-QE，一种有效的混合遗传算法，用法学硕士发现的目标筛选程序取代标准筛选程序，与下游 QCC 更好地保持一致。在整个基准设置中，HGA-QE 与经典基准和基于学习的基准相比，表现出了广泛的竞争性 QCC 性能，并且在严格获胜的两个基准套件中具有更明显的相对优势，这两个基准套件的来源不同于启发式发现所使用的数据。discovers HGA-QE, an effective hybrid genetic algorithm that replaces standard sifting with an LLM-discovered targeted sifting procedure better aligned with downstream QCC. Across the benchmark set, HGA-QE demonstrates broadly competitive QCC performance against both classical and learning-based baselines, with a clearer relative advantage in strict wins on the two benchmark suites drawn from sources different from the data used for heuristic discovery.

2 背景及相关工作Background and Related Work

本节回顾与我们的方法相关的背景和相关工作。This section reviews the background and related work relevant to our approach.

2.1 可逆逻辑与电路综合Reversible Logic and Circuit Synthesis

布尔函数A Boolean functionf:𝔹n→𝔹mf:\mathbb{B}^{n}\rightarrow\mathbb{B}^{m}地图mapsnn二进制输入位binary input bits tomm二进制输出位，其中binary output bits, where𝔹={0,1}\mathbb{B}=\{0,1\}。 可逆函数是具有相同数量的输入和输出位的双射。 虽然一般布尔函数不一定是双射的，但可以通过引入辅助输入和垃圾输出将它们嵌入到可逆函数中. A reversible function is a bijection with the same number of input and output bits. While general Boolean functions are not necessarily bijective, they can be embedded into reversible functions by introducing ancilla inputs and garbage outputs(Wille and Drechsler, 2010)。 由于其信息保存特性，可逆逻辑与一系列应用相关，尤其是量子计算、低功耗设计、光学计算和纳米技术. Due to its information-preserving property, reversible logic is relevant to a range of applications, most notably quantum computing, low power design, optical computing, and nanotechnologies(Landauer, 1961; Saeedi and Markov, 2013; Cuykendall and Andersen, 1987; Merkle, 1993).

可逆电路综合将布尔函数实现为门库上的电路。 我们专注于广泛使用的Reversible circuit synthesis realizes Boolean functions as circuits over a gate library. We focus on the widely usedNCT图书馆NCT library，其中包括 NOT、CNOT 和 Toffoli 门；看到, which comprises NOT, CNOT, and Toffoli gates; seeSection A.1。 NCT图书馆的每个门都有. Each gate in the NCT library withk∈{0,1,2}k\in\{0,1,2\}控制位分配的 QCC 为control bits is assigned a QCC ofCost⁡(k)=2​k2−2​k+1\mathrm{Cost}(k)=2k^{2}-2k+1基于其分解为基本量子门，如下based on its decomposition into elementary quantum gates, followingSzyprowski and Kerntopf (2013)。 电路的总 QCC 是其门成本的总和。. The total QCC of a circuit is the sum of its gate costs.

在综合之前，布尔函数必须以适合操作的形式表示。 尽管真值表通过枚举所有布尔函数提供了布尔函数的规范表示Before synthesis, a Boolean function must be represented in a form suitable for manipulation. Although truth tables provide a canonical representation of Boolean functions by enumerating all2n2^{n}行，由于其指数大小，它们在大规模上变得不切实际。 BDD 为可扩展可逆电路综合提供紧凑的中间表示rows, they become impractical at scale due to their exponential size. BDDs provide compact intermediate representations for scalable reversible circuit synthesis(Wille et al., 2009; Soeken et al., 2016)。 正在关注. FollowingWille et al. (2009)，本工作中考虑的综合过程通过用级联可逆门替换每个非终端 BDD 节点来构造可逆电路。, the synthesis procedure considered in this work constructs reversible circuits by replacing each non-terminal BDD node with a cascade of reversible gates.

2.2 二元决策图和变量排序Binary Decision Diagrams and Variable Ordering

BDD 是布尔函数的有向无环图表示A BDD is a directed acyclic graph representation of a Boolean function(Bryant, 1986)。 每个非终端节点由一个变量标记，并具有两个指向终端或非终端子节点的分支。 当同一个子函数出现在多个地方时，它只表示一次并作为共享子图重用。 构建 BDD 时变量排序很重要，因为它强烈影响结果图的大小。 BDD 大小通常通过非终端节点的数量来衡量，找到最小化该大小的最佳排序是. Each non-terminal node is labeled by one variable and has two branches pointing to terminal or non-terminal child nodes. When the same subfunction appears in multiple places, it is represented once and reused as a shared subgraph. The variable ordering is important when constructing a BDD, as it strongly affects the size of the resulting graph. The BDD size is typically measured by the number of non-terminal nodes, and finding an optimal ordering that minimizes this size is𝒩​𝒫\mathcal{NP}-完整-complete(Bollig and Wegener, 1996)。 尽管 BDD 大小是 QCC 的自然代表，因为所得电路的大小受到 BDD 大小的限制. Although the BDD size is a natural proxy for the QCC because the size of the resulting circuit is bounded by the BDD size(Wille et al., 2009)，它仍然是一个间接代理。, it still remains an indirect proxy.Figure 1表明同一函数的两个排序可以产生具有相同大小但不同 QCC 的 BDD。shows that two orderings of the same function can produce BDDs with the same size but different QCCs.

BDD 变量排序的先前工作包括精确算法Prior work on BDD variable ordering includes exact algorithms(Friedman and Supowit, 1987; Jeong et al., 1993)，启发式算法，例如筛选, heuristic algorithms such as sifting(Rudell, 1993; Panda et al., 1994; Panda and Somenzi, 1995; Meinel et al., 1997)和元启发法，包括遗传算法 (GA)、模拟退火 (SA) 和基于群体的搜索, and metaheuristics including genetic algorithms (GA), simulated annealing (SA), and swarm-based search(Drechsler et al., 1996; Bollig et al., 1995; Awad et al., 2022)。 最近，BDD2Seq. More recently, BDD2Seq(Miao et al., 2026)引入了一种基于学习的方法，该方法使用监督学习来训练图到序列模型来预测顺序。 然而，所有这些方法主要根据 BDD 大小选择排序，而下游 QCC 仅在合成后才能观察到。 这激发了 QCC 感知目标，通过 QCC 而不是 BDD 大小来优化排序。introduced a learning-based approach that trains a graph-to-sequence model using supervised learning to predict the orderings. However, all of these methods primarily select the orderings based on BDD size, while downstream QCC is observed only after synthesis. This motivates a QCC-aware objective that optimizes the orderings by the QCC rather than by the BDD size.

2.3 相关工作Related Work

我们回顾与我们工作相关的基于法学硕士的方法。 第一行研究了法学硕士如何在量子计算工作流程中使用。 最近的量子-法学硕士研究解决了量子计算工作流程中的广泛问题设置。 一些作品评估法学硕士从文本任务提示生成量子代码的能力We review the LLM-based approaches related to our work. The first line examines how LLMs have been used in quantum-computing workflows. Recent Quantum–LLM studies address broad problem settings within the quantum-computing workflow. Some works evaluate LLMs on generating quantum code from textual task prompts(Vishwakarma et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025)。 其他人微调法学硕士以生成用于量子优化任务的参数化量子电路. Others fine-tune LLMs to generate parameterized quantum circuits for quantum optimization tasks(Jern et al., 2025)。 QCircuitBench. QCircuitBench(Yang et al., 2026)在量子算法设计任务上对法学硕士进行基准测试，包括预言机构建和标准量子算法的实现。 Oracle 构建与我们的设置相关，因为它通常需要将布尔函数实现为可逆电路。 然而，QCircuitBench 主要关注教科书级别或特定于算法的预言机，而benchmarks LLMs on quantum algorithm design tasks, including oracle construction and the implementation of standard quantum algorithms. Oracle construction is related to our setting because it often requires implementing Boolean functions as reversible circuits. However, QCircuitBench focuses mainly on textbook-level or algorithm-specific oracles, whereas量子演化QuantumEvo发现以下游 QCC 为目标的 BDD 变量排序启发式合成大型布尔函数。discovers BDD variable ordering heuristics for synthesizing large Boolean functions under downstream QCC as the objective.

第二部分涵盖了法学硕士驱动的算法设计，它为我们的方法提供了方法论基础。 一个互补的工作是使用法学硕士来生成启发式程序，而不是直接预测解决方案。 趣搜The second covers LLM-driven algorithm design, which provides the methodological basis for our approach. A complementary line of work uses LLMs to generate heuristic programs rather than predict solutions directly. FunSearch(Romera-Paredes et al., 2024)引入了用于数学和启发式设计的 LLM 驱动算法搜索，以及 ReEvointroduced LLM-driven algorithm search for mathematical and heuristic design, and ReEvo(Ye et al., 2024)通过反射进化来扩展它以进行组合优化。 最近的框架进一步推进了 LLM 驱动的算法设计extended it with reflective evolution for combinatorial optimization. Recent frameworks have further advanced LLM-driven algorithm design(Zheng et al., 2025; Novikov et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2025; Yao et al., 2025; Dat et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2026; Huang et al., 2026)。 该范例也已应用于特定领域的启发式设计. This paradigm has also been applied to domain-specific heuristic design(Zhao et al., 2026; Shi and Zhen, 2026; Wang et al., 2026). 量子演化QuantumEvo将这一领域特定工作扩展到用于可逆电路综合的 BDD 变量排序。extends this line of domain-specific work to BDD variable ordering for reversible circuit synthesis.

3.2 QuantumEvo：法学硕士驱动的进化启发式设计QuantumEvo: LLM-driven Evolutionary Heuristic Design

量子演化QuantumEvo主要建立在 ReEvo 的反射进化搜索框架之上primarily builds on the reflective evolutionary search framework of ReEvo(Ye et al., 2024)，其中法学硕士生成可执行的启发式程序，这些程序通过评估和反馈进行迭代改进。 从一组种子启发法开始，法学硕士通过修改现有启发法提出新的启发法，并以先前健身结果的自然语言反馈为指导。 我们通过塑造搜索过程的三个特定于领域的设计选择来实例化这种 BDD 变量排序范例：如何表示个体启发式、如何构建初始启发式以及如何定义适应度函数。, in which LLMs generate executable heuristic programs that are iteratively improved through evaluation and feedback. Starting from a set of seed heuristics, the LLM proposes new heuristics by revising existing ones, guided by natural-language feedback on previous fitness results. We instantiate this paradigm for BDD variable ordering through three domain-specific design choices that shape the search process: how individual heuristics are represented, how the initial heuristics are constructed, and how the fitness function is defined.

个人代表Individual representation

每个个体都被表示为一个Each individual is represented as aC与广泛使用的 CUDD（科罗拉多大学决策图）相关的语言功能language function linked with CUDD (Colorado University Decision Diagram), a widely usedC用于构建和操作决策图的库。 这允许生成的启发式方法直接在 BDD 管理器上运行，从而避免了从头开始实现低级 BDD 操作的需要。 相关的 CUDD API 调用列于library for constructing and manipulating decision diagrams. This allows generated heuristics to operate directly on the BDD manager, avoiding the need to implement low-level BDD operations from scratch. The relevant CUDD API calls are listed inSection D.1.

初始启发式构建Initial heuristics construction

初始群体使用三种已建立的 BDD 变量排序方法进行播种：筛选The initial population is seeded using three established BDD variable ordering methods: sifting(Rudell, 1993),遗传算法, GA(Drechsler et al., 1996)，和SA, and SA(Bollig et al., 1995)。 而 ReEvo 从单个种子启发式初始化其搜索，. Whereas ReEvo initializes its search from a single seed heuristic,量子演化QuantumEvo使用来自这三个不同算法系列的种子启发法。 每种方法代表不同的搜索策略，允许法学硕士驱动的进化过程在生成新的启发式方法时重新组合和调整其算法组件。uses seed heuristics from these three distinct algorithmic families. Each method represents a different search strategy, allowing the LLM-driven evolutionary process to recombine and adapt their algorithmic components when generating new heuristics.

健身功能Fitness Function

量子演化QuantumEvo使用下游 QCC 定义适应度函数。 每个有效的个体都被编译，在搜索集上执行，并在完全可逆电路综合后进行评估。 让defines the fitness function using the downstream QCC. Each valid individual is compiled, executed on the search set, and evaluated after full reversible circuit synthesis. Let𝒯\mathcal{T}表示进化过程中使用的搜索集。 对于每个实例denote the search set used during evolution. For each instancef∈𝒯f\in\mathcal{T}, 让, letqfbaseq_{f}^{\mathrm{base}}表示达到的最低 QCCdenote the lowest QCC achieved onff在这项工作中考虑的经典基线方法之一。 生成启发式的适合度among the classical baseline methods considered in this work. The fitness of a generated heuristichh定义为与实例最佳基线的平均相对 QCC 差距：is defined as the average relative QCC gap to the instance-wise best baseline:

fitness⁡(h)=1|𝒯|​∑f∈𝒯q⁡(Ch,f)−qfbaseqfbase.\mathrm{fitness}(h)=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{f\in\mathcal{T}}\frac{q(C_{h,f})-q_{f}^{\mathrm{base}}}{q_{f}^{\mathrm{base}}}. (2)

值越低越好，负值表示相对于该实例的最佳基线的改进。 由于生成的启发式可能包含随机成分，因此每个实例都会对每个有效个体进行多次评估。Lower values are better, and negative values indicate improvement over the best baseline for that instance. Because generated heuristics may contain stochastic components, each valid individual is evaluated multiple times per instance.

4.2 实验结果Experimental Results

我们围绕两个主要发现组织实验结果，然后进行消融研究We organize the experimental results around two main findings, followed by an ablation study of量子演化QuantumEvo。 发现 1 检查 BDD 大小是否是下游 QCC 的可靠代理，发现 2 评估在基准上发现的启发式方法。 然后我们提出了一项消融研究. Finding 1 examines whether BDD size is a reliable proxy for downstream QCC, and Finding 2 evaluates the discovered heuristic on the benchmark. We then present an ablation study of量子演化QuantumEvo分析关键搜索设计选择的影响。to analyze the impact of key search design choices.

4.2.1 发现 1：BDD 大小不能完美地代表下游 QCC。Finding 1: BDD size is an imperfect proxy for downstream QCC.

BDD 变量排序算法通常旨在最小化 BDD 大小。 由于我们的目标是最小化下游 QCC，因此我们首先检查 BDD 大小是否可以作为 QCC 的可靠代理。The BDD variable-ordering algorithms commonly aim to minimize BDD size. Since our objective is to minimize downstream QCC, we first examine whether BDD size serves as a reliable proxy for QCC.Figure 4检查 BDD 大小最多为 1000 的 140 个搜索/验证函数上的 BDD 大小和 QCC 之间的关系。 残差图显示实际 QCC 和拟合 QCC 之间的差异，水平线表示残差为零。 Spearman 指出，QCC 与 BDD 大小密切相关examines the relationship between BDD size and QCC on the 140 search/validation functions with BDD size at most 1000. The residual plot shows the difference between the actual and fitted QCC, with the horizontal line indicating zero residual. QCC is strongly correlated with BDD size, as indicated by Spearmanρ=0.989\rho=0.989，但拟合趋势周围的残差很大。平均绝对偏差为79.3，个体偏差达到980。 此外，这些函数中的 35% 表现出至少一个排序对，其中较小的 BDD 产生较高的 QCC，这表明 BDD 大小并不是一个可靠的指标。 这些观察结果激发了 QCC 感知启发式设计, but residuals around the fitted trend are substantial. The mean absolute deviation is 79.3, with individual deviations reaching 980. Moreover, 35% of these functions exhibit at least one ordering pair in which a smaller BDD yields a higher QCC, suggesting that BDD size is not a reliable proxy. These observations motivate the QCC-aware heuristic design used in量子演化QuantumEvo.

4.2.2 发现 2：HGA-QE 与现有的变量排序基线相比具有竞争力。Finding 2: HGA-QE is competitive with existing variable ordering baselines.

我们选择在独立运行中具有最佳验证适应性的启发式方法，与中分析的方法相对应We select the heuristic with the best validation fitness across independent runs, corresponding to the one analyzed inSection 3.3. On RevLib, it achieves the highest Best count, although its mean QCC is comparable to SA and BDD2Seq has more strict wins. 4.2.3 消融研究Ablation Study of量子演化QuantumEvo

我们研究了三个组成部分We study three components of量子演化QuantumEvo：LLM指导、多家庭初始化和基于QCC的健身。 对于每个设置，我们进行十次独立搜索并比较它们的验证性能: LLM guidance, multi-family initialization, and QCC-based fitness. For each setting, we conduct ten independent searches and compare their validation performance inFigure 6。 然后，我们从每个设置中选择具有最佳验证适应性的个体，并在完整的 148 个功能基准集上对其进行评估。 相应的基准测试结果总结在. We then select the individual with the best validation fitness from each setting and evaluate it on the full 148-function benchmark set. The corresponding benchmark results are summarized inTable 4.

法学硕士指导。LLM guidance.

为了隔离 LLM 的贡献，我们构建了一个非 LLM 启发式生成过程，该过程保留了与以下相同的进化过程、适应度函数、初始化以及搜索和验证集：To isolate the contribution of the LLM, we construct a non-LLM heuristic-generation procedure that retains the same evolutionary procedure, fitness function, initialization, and search and validation sets as量子演化QuantumEvo。 它不是使用 LLM 生成和修改代码，而是从筛选、GA 和 SA 的预定义组件中组装候选者，详细信息请参见. Instead of generating and revising code with an LLM, it assembles candidates from predefined components of sifting, GA, and SA, as detailed inSection C.1。 如图所示. As shown inFigure 6，非 LLM 搜索实现了更强的验证适应性，并且所有十次运行都收敛到 GA 家族个体。 这些结果并不能证明 LLM 指导是一致优越的，但表明超出预定义组件空间的 LLM 驱动的算法设计可以产生更有效地转移到看不见的函数的启发式方法。, the non-LLM search achieves stronger validation fitness, and all ten runs converge to GA-family individuals. These results do not establish that LLM guidance is uniformly superior, but suggest that LLM-driven algorithm design beyond a predefined component space can yield heuristics that transfer more effectively to unseen functions.

多族初始化。Multi-family initialization.

为了评估种子多样性，我们将筛选、GA 和 SA 的多族初始化与单独每个族的初始化进行了比较。 仅 SA 初始化具有零方差，尽管 LLM 具有随机性，但每次运行都会收敛到同一个体，这表明单个种子家族可以限制探索的区域。 仅 GA 初始化比多族初始化实现了更好的验证 QCC 适应性，而多族初始化获得了更高的验证胜负率。 然而，在完整的基准测试中，在仅 GA 初始化下选择的启发式不再领先，并且在仅 SA 和仅筛选初始化下选择的启发式也表现不佳 HGA-QE。To assess seed diversity, we compare the multi-family initialization of sifting, GA, and SA against initialization from each family alone. SA-only initialization has zero variance, with every run converging to the same individual despite LLM stochasticity, indicating that a single seed family can constrain the explored region. GA-only initialization achieves better validation QCC fitness than multi-family initialization, whereas multi-family initialization attains a higher validation win-or-tie rate. On the full benchmark, however, the heuristic selected under GA-only initialization no longer leads, and the heuristics selected under SA-only and sifting-only initialization also underperform HGA-QE.

基于QCC的健身。QCC-based fitness.

最后，我们用 BDD 大小替换下游 QCC 目标，同时保留Finally, we replace the downstream QCC objective with BDD size while retaining the remaining components of量子演化QuantumEvo。 BDD 大小设置显示出不太有利的中值验证 QCC 适合度. The BDD-size setting shows a less favorable median validation QCC fitness inFigure 6。 其选择的启发式也低于基准上相应的基于 QCC 的设置，具有较低的最佳和严格最佳率以及较高的平均 QCC。. Its selected heuristic also underperforms the corresponding QCC-based setting on the benchmark, with lower Best and Strictly Best rates and higher mean QCC.

5 讨论Discussion

虽然结果表明 LLM 驱动的进化搜索可以发现竞争性 BDD 变量排序启发法，但仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，发现的启发式方法仍然受到用于种子搜索的初始启发式系列的影响。 虽然最好的谱系从​​ SA 家族个体过渡到 GA 家族个体，但最好的启发式结合并完善了与筛选、SA 和 GA 相关的想法，而不是引入全新的排序策略类别。 替代框架设计是否能够发现本质上不同且更有效的排序策略仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。 第二，While the results demonstrate that LLM-driven evolutionary search can discover competitive BDD variable ordering heuristics, several limitations remain. First, the discovered heuristic is still influenced by the initial heuristic families used to seed the search. Although the best lineage transitions from SA-family to GA-family individuals, the best heuristic combines and refines ideas related to sifting, SA, and GA rather than introducing an entirely new class of ordering strategy. Whether alternative framework designs can discover substantially different and more effective ordering strategies remains an open question. Second,量子演化QuantumEvo优化了基于 BDD 的可逆综合的一个重要组成部分，即变量排序。 虽然这种选择会影响 BDD 结构和下游 QCC，但其他资源度量（例如辅助计数）也取决于合成过程本身。 未来的工作可以结合起来optimizes an important component of BDD-based reversible synthesis, namely the variable ordering. While this choice affects the BDD structure and downstream QCC, other resource measures, such as ancilla count, also depend on the synthesis procedure itself. Future work could combine量子演化QuantumEvo使用合成后辅助缩减技术或可产生低成本电路的替代合成方法。 第三，非法学硕士搜索保持竞争力，同时避免法学硕士指导的令牌和推理成本。这表明混合策略可以通过主要依赖预定义的进化算子并在需要额外的算法变化时选择性地调用 LLM 来降低离线发现成本。with post-synthesis ancilla reduction techniques or alternative synthesis methods that produce lower-cost circuits. Third, the non-LLM search remains competitive while avoiding the token and inference costs of LLM guidance. This suggests that hybrid strategies could reduce offline discovery cost by relying primarily on predefined evolutionary operators and invoking the LLM selectively when additional algorithmic variation is needed.

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了We presented量子演化QuantumEvo，一个 LLM 驱动的进化框架，发现可解释和可重用的 BDD 变量排序启发式，用于可逆电路综合。 最佳发现的启发式 HGA-QE 在不同的基准电路中实现了有竞争力的 QCC，并在大量函数子集上改进了经典的 CUDD 排序方法和基于学习的基线。 它作为通用 CUDD 变量排序启发式的实现也使其能够在其他基于 BDD 的工作流程中重用。 更广泛地说，, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that discovers interpretable and reusable BDD variable ordering heuristics for reversible circuit synthesis. The best discovered heuristic, HGA-QE, achieves competitive QCC across diverse benchmark circuits and improves over classical CUDD ordering methods and learning-based baselines on a substantial subset of functions. Its implementation as a general CUDD variable-ordering heuristic also enables its reuse in other BDD-based workflows. More broadly,量子演化QuantumEvo说明了如何通过直接根据相关下游目标评估候选人来使基于法学硕士的启发式设计适应特定领域的设置。 这种方法可以扩展到嵌入专门计算工作流程中的其他优化决策。illustrates how LLM-based heuristic design can be adapted to domain-specific settings by evaluating candidates directly on the relevant downstream objective. This approach may extend to other optimization decisions embedded within specialized computational workflows.

附录BAppendix B详细的实验设置Detailed Experimental Setup

本节提供重现和解释实验所需的补充细节。This section provides supplementary details needed to reproduce and interpret the experiments.

B.1 CUDD 中的基线排序方法Baseline Ordering Methods in CUDD

CUDD (Somenzi, 2023)是一个is aC用于构建和操作 BDD 的库。 CUDD 中实现的经典基线是：library for constructing and manipulating BDDs. The classical baselines implemented in CUDD are:

  • •

    过筛Sifting (Rudell, 1993)：将每个变量移动到所有可能的级别并保留最小节点数的位置。: Moves each variable through all possible levels and retains the position minimizing node count.

  • •

    对称筛选Symmetric Sifting (Panda et al., 1994)：通过在遍历期间检测对称变量对并将它们分组以进行联合筛选来扩展筛选。: Extends sifting by detecting symmetric variable pairs during traversal and grouping them for joint sifting.

  • •

    群体筛选Group Sifting (Panda and Somenzi, 1995)：将对称筛选推广到任意因变量组，将每个组作为一个整体进行筛选。: Generalizes symmetric sifting to arbitrary dependent variable groups, sifting each group as a whole.

  • •

    遗传算法Genetic Algorithm (Drechsler et al., 1996)：维护可变排序的群体；通过交叉产生新的个体，并在适应度评估之前对每个个体进行筛选，如果后代有所改善，则替换最差的个体。: Maintains a population of variable orderings; generates new individuals via crossover and sifts each before fitness evaluation, replacing the worst individual if the offspring improves.

  • •

    模拟退火Simulated Annealing (Bollig et al., 1995)：随机扰乱排序并根据退火时间表接受或拒绝移动。: Randomly perturbs the ordering and accepts or rejects moves according to an annealing schedule.

B.2 实验设置Experimental Setting

超参数Hyperparameters

Table 5总结了所有运行中使用的超参数。summarizes the hyperparameters used in all runs.

个人代表Individual Representation

每个人都是一个与 CUDD 直接链接的程序。 我们不是在 Python 级别实现个体，而是使用链接到 BDD 流程的函数，这避免了每步接口开销，并提供对 CUDD 排序例程和相关内部数据结构的更直接访问。Each individual is a program linked directly to CUDD. Rather than implementing individuals at the Python level, we use functions linked into the BDD process, which avoids per-step interface overhead and provides more direct access to CUDD ordering routines and relevant internal data structures.

初始启发法Initial Heuristics

初始启发式是由对应于筛选、GA 和 SA 的三个函数生成的。 筛选和模拟退火种子遵循相应的 CUDD 实现，而 GA 种子是 CUDD 中 GA 的轻量级变体，仅减少总体规模以保持评估成本可控。The initial heuristics are generated from three functions corresponding to sifting, GA, and SA. The sifting and simulated annealing seeds follow the corresponding CUDD implementations, while the GA seed is a lightweight variant of GA in CUDD that only reduces the population size to keep evaluation cost manageable.

B.3 数据集和基准分析Analysis of Dataset and Benchmarks

RevLib 与可逆电路综合相结合，并提供可在有限搜索预算内重复评估的功能。 为了增加搜索池的多样性，我们增强了 RevLib。RevLib is aligned with reversible circuit synthesis and provides functions that can be repeatedly evaluated within the limited search budget. To increase the diversity of the search pool, we augment RevLib.Figure 9通过输入计数、输出计数和门计数将 100 个搜索函数与 148 个基准函数进行比较。 搜索集取自增强的 RevLib 函数，而基准集则由具有更广泛结构多样性的 RevLib、LGSynth91 和 ISCAS85/89 函数组成。 与搜索设置点一致的基准点对应于 RevLib 基准函数。 这种重叠仅在元数据级别，并且搜索和基准集不共享布尔函数。 相比之下，与任何搜索设置点都不重合的基准点对应于非 RevLib 套件 LGSynth91 和 ISCAS85/89。 因此，非 RevLib 套件引入了具有输入、输出和门计数配置的基准函数，这些配置在基于 RevLib 的搜索集中未观察到。compares the 100 search functions with the 148 benchmark functions by input count, output count, and gate count. The search set is drawn from augmented RevLib functions, whereas the benchmark set consists of RevLib, LGSynth91, and ISCAS85/89 functions with broader structural variety. The benchmark points that coincide with the search-set points correspond to RevLib benchmark functions. This overlap is only at the metadata level, and the search and benchmark sets share no Boolean functions. By contrast, the benchmark points that do not coincide with any search-set point correspond to the non-RevLib suites, LGSynth91 and ISCAS85/89. Thus, the non-RevLib suites introduce benchmark functions with input, output, and gate-count configurations not observed in the RevLib-based search set.

附录CAppendix C附加分析Additional Analyses of量子演化QuantumEvo

C.1 非LLM进化搜索的细节Details of the Non-LLM Evolutionary Search

我们将非 LLM 控制实现为一种进化搜索，遵循生成超启发式范式，从预定义的算法组件构建候选者We implement the non-LLM control as an evolutionary search that constructs candidates from predefined algorithmic components, following the generation hyper-heuristic paradigm(Burke et al., 2009; Burke et al., 2013; Lin et al., 2020)。 它使用与以下相同的进化过程、适应度函数、初始化方案以及搜索和验证集：. It uses the same evolutionary procedure, fitness function, initialization scheme, and search and validation sets as量子演化QuantumEvo，仅在启发式生成方面有所不同。 通过从总结的搜索空间中选择和组合预定义的算法组件来组装候选者, differing only in heuristic generation. The candidates are assembled by selecting and combining predefined algorithmic components from the search space summarized inTable 6，而不是由法学硕士生成和迭代修订。 每个人都对所有维度进行编码，但只有与所选系列相关的维度才会影响最终的实现。 搜索空间由三个启发式家族组成：筛选、GA 和 SA。 这些对应于用于初始化的三个种子启发法, rather than being generated and iteratively revised by an LLM. Each individual encodes all dimensions, but only those associated with the selected family affect the resulting implementation. The search space consists of three heuristic families, sifting, GA, and SA. These correspond to the three seed heuristics used to initialize量子演化QuantumEvo。 初始种群包含来自每个家族的 10 个个体，与使用的循环初始化相匹配. The initial population contains ten individuals from each family, matching the round-robin initialization used by量子演化QuantumEvo。 非 LLM 搜索可以修改和组合各种预定义组件，包括 GA 中嵌入的筛选程序。 然而，它不能在这个预定义的空间之外引入新的算法思想，例如. The non-LLM search can modify and combine a broad range of predefined components, including the sifting procedure embedded within the GA. D.4 HGA-QE 在逻辑综合流程中的应用Application of HGA-QE to a Logic-Synthesis Flow

我们进一步评估现场可编程门阵列 (FPGA) 逻辑综合流程中的 HGA-QE。 之前的工作已经研究了 BDD 变量排序如何影响质量 从所得 BDD 合成的电路We further evaluate HGA-QE in a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) logic-synthesis flow. Prior work has examined how BDD variable ordering affects the quality of circuits synthesized from the resulting BDDs(Popel, 2002; Drechsler et al., 2004)。 我们将此评估扩展到 FPGA 技术映射，将布尔网络转换为目标 FPGA 架构支持的固定输入查找表 (LUT) 网络. We extend this evaluation to FPGA technology mapping, which transforms a Boolean network into a network of fixed-input lookup tables (LUTs) supported by the target FPGA architecture(Cong and Ding, 1994)。 为此，每个有序 BDD 都导出为布尔网络 其中每个BDD节点被表示为一个多路复用器。 由此产生的多路复用器网络的结构尺寸紧密遵循 BDD 尺寸。 然后使用 Yosys 综合网络并映射到四输入 LUT. For this purpose, each ordered BDD is exported as a Boolean network in which each BDD node is represented as a multiplexer. The structural size of the resulting multiplexer network closely follows the BDD size. The network is then synthesized and mapped to four-input LUTs using Yosys(Wolf and Glaser, 2013).

我们对 LGSynth91 的 52 个函数进行了实验 ISCAS85/89，因为这些套件包含传统的布尔逻辑 与 FPGA 综合更直接一致的基准测试 RevLib 中的可逆电路技术映射。 结果总结为We conduct the experiment on 52 functions from LGSynth91 and ISCAS85/89, as these suites contain conventional Boolean logic benchmarks that are more directly aligned with FPGA synthesis and technology mapping than the reversible circuits in RevLib. The result is summarized intable 14。 筛选是确定性的并且运行一次，而 GA、SA 和 HGA-QE 均使用五个种子运行。 对于每个基准测试和方法，我们报告运行期间的最佳、平均和最差多路复用器网络大小和 LUT 计数。 汇总统计数据仅包括每个阶段 300 秒预算内完成所有所需种子的基准。 HGA-QE 仅部分完成. Sifting is deterministic and is run once, whereas GA, SA, and HGA-QE are each run with five seeds. For each benchmark and method, we report the best, average, and worst multiplexer-network sizes and LUT counts across the runs. Aggregate statistics include only benchmarks for which all required seeds completed within the 300s budget for each stage. HGA-QE completed only partially onc432和andc880，虽然没有种子完成, while no seed completed on旋转原版rot_orig。 对于 GA，下游映射仅部分完成. For GA, downstream mapping completed only partially on对原点pair_orig并没有完成and did not complete on旋转原版rot_orig。 因此，这些基准被排除在总体统计数据之外。 HGA-QE 实现了导出多路复用器网络的最高最佳/总计数。 但在与 FPGA 映射相关的目标下，它的性能并没有优于最强的基线 SA 和 GA。. These benchmarks were therefore excluded from the aggregate statistics. HGA-QE achieves the highest Best/Total count for the exported mux networks. But it does not outperform the strongest baselines, SA and GA, under the objective related to FPGA mapping.

离线搜索成本Offline Search Cost

的The量子演化QuantumEvo设置由 10 个独立的搜索组成，使用setting consists of 10 independent searches usinggpt-oss-120b。在这些运行中，每次搜索平均使用 291.6 个 LLM 调用、311 万个输入标记和 104 万个输出标记。 平均挂钟时间为 108.5 分钟。该模型在单个 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上自行托管。 我们仅报告搜索过程中使用的推理资源，并将预训练底层 LLM 的成本视为外部成本。 经典的 CUDD 启发法不需要类似的发现阶段。 BDD2Seq 报告其训练硬件和超参数，但不报告模型训练所需的挂钟时间或 GPU 小时数。 因此，其原始线下成本无法与线下成本直接比较。. Across these runs, each search used an average of 291.6 LLM calls, 3.11M input tokens, and 1.04M output tokens. The mean wall-clock time was 108.5 minutes. The model was self-hosted on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU. We report only the inference resources used during the search and treat the cost of pretraining the underlying LLM as external. Classical CUDD heuristics require no analogous discovery phase. BDD2Seq reports its training hardware and hyperparameters, but not the wall-clock time or GPU-hours required for model training. Its original offline cost therefore cannot be directly compared with that of量子演化QuantumEvo.

离线编译评估成本Offline Compilation and Evaluation Cost

每个到达评估阶段的候选者都会在 100 个函数搜索集上进行编译和评估。 对于每个函数，评估都会在计算 QCC 之前调用可逆合成管道两次。 每次运行最多 200 个候选评估，这相当于每次运行最多约 40,000 个综合调用。 在Each candidate reaching the evaluation stage is compiled and evaluated on the 100-function search set. For every function, the evaluation invokes the reversible-synthesis pipeline twice before computing QCC. With a maximum of 200 candidate evaluations per run, this corresponds to up to approximately 40,000 synthesis calls per run. In the量子演化QuantumEvo设置中，8.3% 的候选评估达到了 40 秒超时。 完成的评估要求平均值为 9.3 秒，中位数为 7.0 秒，第 95 个百分位数为 26.0 秒。setting, 8.3% of candidate evaluations reached the 40 s timeout. The completed evaluations required a mean of 9.3 s, a median of 7.0 s, and a 95th percentile of 26.0 s.

在线费用Online Cost

应用 HGA-QE 不需要法学硕士课程。 发现后，HGA-QE 将作为固定编译启发式部署。 因此，其在线成本仅包括 BDD 重新排序、可逆综合和 QCC 评估，所有这些都包含在基准运行时测量中。 与 HGA-QE 不同，BDD2Seq 需要每个实例的神经推理。Applying HGA-QE requires no LLM calls. After discovery, HGA-QE is deployed as a fixed compiled heuristic. Its online cost therefore consists only of BDD reordering, reversible synthesis, and QCC evaluation, all of which are included in the benchmark runtime measurements. Unlike HGA-QE, BDD2Seq requires per-instance neural inference.
